The further origin is uncertain. The Germanic verb has tentatively been connected with a metathesized s-mobile form of *kleh₂w- (“hook, peg, latch”), potentially relating it to Latin claudō (“to close”), but this connection is disputed.
Compare Norwegian Nynorsk slutt, Swedish slut and Danish slut, as well as Dutch slo
